_note: Sample clinic configuration. Every clinic replaces this with its own lens catalogue, optimised A-constants, drop protocol and contacts.

monofocal.name: Monofocal
sources: Standard aspheric monofocal: uncorrected intermediate acuity 0.32 logMAR at 66 cm (-1.5 D). Eom Y et al., Sci Rep 2025, doi:10.1038/s41598-025-89547-3 (TECNIS ZCB00 arm).

edof.name: EDOF
sources: ZEISS AT LARA family brochure (manufacturer, 14 eyes, 3 months): better than 0.1 logMAR to about 55 cm and better than 0.2 logMAR to about 45 cm.
Independent single-centre series (monocular, distance-corrected, n=17): about 0.12 logMAR at 60 cm and 0.40 logMAR at 40 cm.
Reinhard T et al., Graefes Arch Clin Exp Ophthalmol 2021, doi:10.1007/s00417-020-04868-5: randomised trial; AT LARA 829MP had the widest monocular depth of focus vs TECNIS Symfony and a monofocal.

macular_disease.reason: Macular disease: reduced contrast may limit the benefit of an extended-range lens.

glaucoma.reason: Glaucoma: mild contrast loss with extended-range optics.

diabetic_retinopathy.reason: Diabetic retinopathy: retinal disease may limit the benefit.

dry_eye.reason: Dry eye: treat the ocular surface before final planning.

prior_refractive_surgery.reason: Previous refractive surgery: less predictable outcome with premium optics.

trifocal.name: Trifocal
sources: ZEISS AT LISA tri clinical leaflet (manufacturer): visual acuity better than 0.10 logMAR from distance to 40 cm (2.5 D).
AT LISA tri 839MP 6-month study, Fernandez-Vega Institute (102 patients): binocular distance-corrected intermediate acuity 0.07-0.11 logMAR at 50-70 cm.
AT LISA tri 839MP vs AcrySof PanOptix comparisons: mean defocus curve between 0.0 and 0.1 logMAR from 0 to -3.00 D.
trifocal.example_models_toric: e.g. ZEISS AT LISA tri toric 939MP

macular_disease.reason: Macular disease: diffractive multifocal lenses are generally avoided.

amblyopia.reason: Amblyopia: limited potential acuity, multifocal benefit unlikely.

glaucoma.reason: Glaucoma: diffractive optics reduce contrast sensitivity further.

diabetic_retinopathy.reason: Diabetic retinopathy: risk of macular oedema; multifocal optics are a relative contraindication.

dry_eye.reason: Dry eye degrades multifocal image quality. Treat first.

prior_refractive_surgery.reason: Previous refractive surgery: higher-order aberrations and power surprises are more likely.

_defocus_note: defocus_curve: [vergence D, monocular logMAR] points. Shapes are anchored to the published summary figures in each family's 'sources' (manufacturer leaflets and peer-reviewed studies); full per-step tables were not available, so points between the anchors are interpolated. Replace with the published curves for the exact lenses the clinic stocks. halo: 0-1 relative night halo/glare noticeability.

strategies.name: Blended vision: monofocal, one eye set for near

_strategies_note: families/targets are [dominant eye, non-dominant eye]. Targets are post-op spherical equivalent in dioptres; negative = set for nearer.
